CORRECTION_2_THE_TARGET_IS_NOT_0.5.why_it_matters: 0.5205 is the MEASURED home rate over the 1,684-game canonical pool. Shrinking to 0.5 discards the measured home-field advantage and biases every low-dose forecast against the home side by about half a point of probability, systematically, on exactly the games where the model knows least.

PROPOSAL: consume dose inside the model rather than labelling it afterward. AGREED, adopted, and corrected in two places before adoption.

limit_test.market: COL@ATL, market p_home 0.680, priced well away from the league prior
limit_test.shrink_the_edge: edge -> 0.00pp as dose -> 0, which is what no information has to mean
limit_test.shrink_the_probability: edge -> -15.95pp as dose -> 0, which is exactly |prior - market|. At ZERO information the model is credited with a 15.9pp disagreement it did not produce. That number is a market fact — the book is priced away from the league rate — not a model finding.

THE_REAL_DEFECT_IN_THE_PROPOSED_MECHANIS.proposal: shrink the probability toward the prior, compare to the market, keep the threshold
THE_REAL_DEFECT_IN_THE_PROPOSED_MECHANIS.result: THE APPARENT EDGE GREW ON 9 OF 14 GAMES. LAD@DET went 5.20pp -> 11.33pp. Removing information made the system look MORE confident about disagreeing with the market.
THE_REAL_DEFECT_IN_THE_PROPOSED_MECHANIS.the_proposal_hit_this_itself: its own worked table shows KC@CLE going -0.9pp to +11.3pp and labels it 'fake edge from missing data'. The defect was caught by hand, not by the mechanism. A rule a human has to override on 9 of 14 rows is not the rule.
THE_REAL_DEFECT_IN_THE_PROPOSED_MECHANIS.why_it_happens: the market is priced away from the prior. Pulling the model TOWARD the prior pulls it AWAY from the market. Shrinking a point estimate is not the same operation as widening an interval, and only the second is what low information means.

WHAT_WAS_IMPLEMENTED.bar: fixed at 3.0pp against the dose-scaled edge. An earlier attempt scaled the BAR by 1/dose instead and it was not enough — COL@ATL still cleared 15.65pp against a 15.00pp bar, i.e. the largest surviving edge sat on the game with the WORST information. Recorded because the intermediate fix looked convincing and was insufficient.
WHAT_WAS_IMPLEMENTED.decision_edge: effective_edge_pp = dose * (p_raw - market). Goes to zero as dose goes to zero. This is the ONLY edge a forecast may claim.
WHAT_WAS_IMPLEMENTED.point_estimate: shrink_to_prior stays, targeting the REGISTERED prior. p_home_dosed is what gets reported as the probability; it is the right point estimate.
